settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: LLM connection settings that apply server-wide.
settings.cli.title: CLI models
settings.cli.subtitle: Which model each CLI answers with when the connection type is CLI (key-less, with a subscription sign-in). LLM visibility tests and the site assistant use this choice; if left empty, *_CLI_MODEL from .env applies, and otherwise the CLI's default.
settings.cli.note: Changing the model also changes the cache key, so the same query is asked again with the new model instead of hitting the 24-hour cache. Perplexity has no CLI and only works with an API key.
settings.cli.listError: The model list could not be fetched from the CLI; you can enter the model name by hand.
settings.cli.agyHint: Choose a Gemini model so the Gemini column is really Gemini.
